structure.en: you really went and did it!

patterns.name: 〜やがる
patterns.explanation: やがる stuck onto a verb is rough speech that shows anger at the person who did it. やりやがった = 'you damn well did it'.

patterns.name: 〜な (sentence end)
patterns.explanation: な at the end of a sentence shows the speaker reacting with feeling to what happened, here stretched out. やりやがったなー = 'you really went and did it!'
